original.statement: Loki Ruler gains the ability to disable the X-Scope-OrgId tenant header in remote write requests.

decision.reason: [ev-b01a3de73bcb] lists this under 3.0.0 Features: the Ruler gains the ability to disable the `X-Scope-OrgId` tenant identification header in remote write requests. That supports a new opt-in protocol-behavior capability scoped to the ruler component, recorded as "added". The evidence does not name the config key, so the free-form protocol-behavior subject built from the evidence's own key words is the most precise identity it supports.
